about: Send feedback or a complaint about an ICP service or transaction.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Submit a complaint to ICP. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Give full details of the complaint and attach supporting papers if any
documents: Supporting papers where relevant; no fixed list
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
